assertion_results.text: Remediation task descriptions include a Coordination Guidance subsection in Implementation Notes with customer-shipped guidance text
assertion_results.evidence: All four remediation task descriptions (Task 1 dependency bump 2.2.x, Task 2 downstream propagation 2.2.x, Task 3 upstream backport 2.1.x, Task 4 downstream propagation 2.1.x) contain a '### Coordination Guidance' subsection nested under '## Implementation Notes'. Each begins with 'This component is shipped to customers.' confirming customer-shipped context.

assertion_results.text: The customer-shipped guidance mentions coordinating with Product Security for CVE assignment, advisory preparation, and formal disclosure
assertion_results.evidence: All four Coordination Guidance subsections contain the identical text: 'Coordinate with Product Security for CVE assignment, advisory preparation, and formal disclosure. Fix must be released via a security advisory with explicit CVE-to-component mapping.' This covers CVE assignment, advisory preparation, and formal disclosure as required.
